title: Laundry Sorter
shareTitle: Laundry Sorter — Sort It, Fold It, Find the Pairs
description: Sort a changing mix of colorful clothes, fold shirts, pants, and towels step by step, and match a broad collection of colorful patterned socks in a cheerful storybook laundry room for ages 5–6.
learningGoals: Follow realistic three-step clothing-fold sequences with directional swipes
Build helping-at-home pride through a short laundry routine
interactionModel: finger-tracked drag plus tap-tap sorting, staged directional folding swipes, and face-up pair matching
feedbackModel: Correct chores use soft fabric motion, sparkles, bubbles, basket counts, and warm recorded praise; misses wobble gently and replay a spoken model.
